subject: Gridline security kickoff & stakeholder confirmation
body:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@gridline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0400
Subject: Gridline security kickoff & stakeholder confirmation

Hi Erin — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call recap (short):
- Goal: understand Gridline's security/procurement gates and confirm stakeholders so Redwood can scope the security review and questionnaire intake.
- High-level constraint: Gridline prefers vendor onboarding complete by EOM Oct (internal deadline).

Stakeholders we captured on the call (please confirm):
- Economic buyer / Sponsor: Erin Walsh (you)
- Procurement lead: Samir Patel (procurement)
- IT owner (network & firewall): Aditi Rao
- Security reviewer: TBD (you mentioned SecOps will review questionnaire)
- Implementation / Data owner: Product Ops team (we haven't gotten a named contact)

Immediate asks for us:
1) Confirm the final list of approvers (names + emails) so we can route the questionnaire to the right people.
2) Confirm systems/appliances in scope for the initial review. From our discovery notes you mentioned: customer data ingestion pipelines, API gateway (public endpoints), and SFTP ingestion host. Are there any additional hosts/services to include?
3) Can Samir/Procurement confirm the contracting path (SOW + PO or standard MSA + SOW)? Any procurement redlines we should expect?

Attachments: attaching the initial security questionnaire (security_questionnaire_v1.pdf) and a brief Redwood data flow description that outlines where data can be stored or proxied (redwood_data_flow_description.docx). I'll also include a short checklist for the technical deep-dive we propose.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- Today: confirm stakeholders and scope (action: Erin + Samir)
- Thu 23 Sep: 30m technical deep-dive with your IT/security team (we proposed Marissa + Ben from our side)
- Fri 24 Sep: Redwood returns completed baseline questionnaire + evidence links for SOC2/pen test

Let me know whether Thu 23 Sep 11:00-11:30 ET works or suggest two alternative times. If procurement wants contract language up front, we can have our legal attach a standard MSA while the security intake runs in parallel.

Thanks — rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198


From: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@gridline.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gridline.com>, Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@gridline.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 12:16:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Gridline security kickoff & stakeholder confirmation

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the stakeholders below:
- Economic buyer / Sponsor: Erin Walsh <erin.walsh@gridline.com>
- Procurement: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gridline.com>
- IT (network): Aditi Rao <aditi.rao@gridline.com>
- Security reviewer: I looped in Aaron Liu from SecOps (aaron.liu@gridline.com) separately — he'll take the questionnaire and validate the scope.
- Implementation / Data owner: I'll introduce Maya Choudhury from Product Ops in the technical meeting.

Scope clarifications:
- In-scope for initial review: API endpoints that accept customer PII, the SFTP host used for nightly ingests, and the transient object store we use for inference.
- Out-of-scope for now: internal analytics pipeline and any batch jobs that only process anonymized telemetry.

Procurement notes (Samir added inline):
- We typically do MSA + SOW. For vendors handling PII we require SOC2 Type II evidence and a short DPIA if data residency could change.
- Expected contracting timeline: 3-4 weeks once security is satisfied.

Attachments: attaching our internal network boundary diagram for the items above (gridline_network_boundary_v2.png).

Thu 23 Sep 11:00 ET works for the technical deep-dive. Please send a calendar invite with dial-in and queue items.

—Erin
Head of Partnerships, Gridline Financial
erin.walsh@gridline.com | (212) 555-0110


On Wed, Sep 22, 2027 at 09:18 AM -0700, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Erin / Samir / Aditi —
>
> Great, thanks for the confirmations and the network diagram. Per Erin that Thu 23 Sep 11:00 ET slot is good — calendar invite sent to all. Attendees from our side: Marissa Cole (security intake lead) and Ben Carter (solutions architect).
>
> Quick notes and deliverables we committed to on the call:
> - Redwood to provide completed baseline questionnaire and evidence links by end of day Fri 24 Sep. Evidence set will include SOC2 summary + relevant control mappings and a copy of our latest pen test report (if available).
> - Marissa will own the intake and will route technical questions to Ben for the deep-dive.
> - If Aaron (SecOps) requests, we can provide a temporary scoped network diagram highlighting ingress/egress for the Gridline integration.
>
> Action items (owners):
> - Erin: confirm Aaron and Maya are on the invite (done)
> - Samir: confirm contracting path and whether a PO or SOW-first is preferred (Samir to reply)
> - Marissa: prepare the evidence bundle and fill security_questionnaire_v1.pdf by Fri 24 Sep
> - Ben: prepare a 15-minute tech walkthrough (API auth, data retention options, KV caching behavior) for Thu 23 Sep deep-dive
>
> If procurement needs a redline or term sheet early, loop me and our legal counsel and we can fast-track. Appreciate the quick cadence — speak Thu.
>
> Best,
> Rishi
>
> --
> Rishi Malhotra | Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
